thread:
Priya Rao: Need help fast — specialty pharmacy rejected my e-prescription for my biologic at pickup. Pharmacist said the BIN/PCN on the payer lookup doesn't match Redwood's plan and claims are routing to a different PBM. I'm being asked for a "Payer ID/BIN" to override. Anyone know what values to give them? I'm about to miss a dose.

Maya - People Ops: Sorry Priya, that's stressful. Quick checklist: 1) Don't give SSN or full member ID in channel. 2) If you can, DM the pharmacy an image of your Redwood digital ID card (portal > ID card) which should include BIN/PCN/Payer ID — some cards show MC/GRP/BIN/PCN/RxBIN.

Priya Rao: DM'd a screenshot of my card (redacted member #). Pharmacist still says system shows PBM "MedLinkRx" and won't process.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: Digital ID cards are the canonical proof. If pharmacy system lookup returns different PBM, we can escalate to carrier/PBM for override. To request an immediate fill override, we need: pharmacy NPI, refill Rx#, date of service, and a copy of the pharmacy's rejection message/EOB. Upload these to Benefits Portal > Claims & Rx Help.

Pharmacy Ops: Hi Priya — can you ask the pharmacist for the exact rejection code or screenshot? Many systems display a reject like "BIN MISMATCH" with the BIN they tried and the PBM name. If you can get the BIN/PCN they looked up that helps. We can then contact ZenithCare to push a pharmacy routing override.

Priya Rao: Pharmacist sent: "Reject 82: BIN 012345 / PCN ABCD / PBM MedLinkRx." They said they tried BIN on file for "Aurelia Commercial" (my old employer).

Maya - People Ops: Thanks. That explains it — the pharmacy system still has your old employer PBM info. @ZenithCare Rep can you trigger a pharmacy routing correction so the BIN maps to Redwood's PBM? Also we may need a one-time override for today's fill.

ZenithCare Rep: We can do both. For a same-day override we need: member name, DOB, last 4 of member ID (send via DM), pharmacy NPI and phone, and the Rx#/NDC. Once we confirm, we can issue an authorization code to the pharmacy (usually within 2 hours during business hours). To permanently fix routing we submit a PBM mapping update; that can take 3-6 business days depending on clearinghouse.

Pharmacy Ops: If ZenithCare provides an authorization code, the pharmacist can manually adjudicate the claim and bill the correct PBM. If the pharmacy refuses, we can request a paper claim submission or help with appeal after the fact.

Priya Rao: Sent the DM with last 4 and DOB, plus the pharmacy NPI and Rx#. Appreciate the quick help — pharmacist said they can hold the drug 2 hours while we get auth.

Benefits Bot: Ticket created: #RX-2024-786. ZenithCare assigned internal case #ZC-RX-9981. Estimated resolution: same-day override pending business hours; PBM mapping 2-3 business days.

Maya - People Ops: Follow-up: once the override is complete, upload the receipt/EOB if any copay was charged incorrectly and we'll help get a refund. If the claim ends up processed under the wrong PBM and you had to pay, file via Benefits Portal > Reimbursement and tag us.

Priya Rao: Thank you everyone — pharmacy called, they got the authorization code and filled it. You're lifesavers. :pray:

Maya - People Ops: Great news. We'll keep the PBM mapping case open until it's fixed in vendor directories. Closing loop here in 3 business days unless Priya reports otherwise.
